MUSIC AND DANCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Instrumental Transpositions: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Instrumental Transpositions.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Instrumental Transpositions.
   C. Practise Instrumental Transpositions with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Instrumental Transpositions.

2. Best practice when working on Contemporary Songs from Kenya: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Contemporary Songs from Kenya.
   B. Practise Contemporary Songs from Kenya with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Contemporary Songs from Kenya.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Contemporary Songs from Kenya.

3. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble.
   D. Practise Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Dance Production: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Dance Production.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Dance Production.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Dance Production.

6. Best practice when working on Four-Part Harmony: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Four-Part Harmony.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Four-Part Harmony.
   C. Practise Four-Part Harmony with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Four-Part Harmony.

7. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Replace drinking water

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

9. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software.: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software..
   B. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software..
   C. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software..
   D. Practise Music Notation Software. with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Western Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Western Ensembles.
   B. Practise Western Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Western Ensembles.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Western Ensembles.

11. Best practice when working on Kenyan Contemporary Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Contemporary Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Contemporary Songs.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Contemporary Songs.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Contemporary Songs.

12. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Music and Dance Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Instrumental Transpositions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Setting Text to Music and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Practise Instrumental Transpositions with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. B — Practise Contemporary Songs from Kenya with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. D — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. D — Practise Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. A — Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. C — Practise Four-Part Harmony with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. A — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

8. D — Red, blue, and yellow

9. D — Practise Music Notation Software. with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. B — Practise Western Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. A — Practise Kenyan Contemporary Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. D — The speed of the music
